body.heading: Nia's Garden
paragraphs: Nia had one tiny tomato seed. She dug a small hole in the garden and tucked the seed inside. Every morning, Nia watered the soil with her blue watering can.
For six days, nothing happened. On the seventh day, Nia saw a tiny green sprout pushing up. 'You did it!' she whispered.
By the end of summer, the plant was tall and strong, and it held three red tomatoes. Nia picked the biggest one and shared it with her little brother.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Nia waited six days with nothing to see. What is something you have had to wait patiently for?
2. Why do you think Nia shared the biggest tomato instead of keeping it?

takeaway: Good readers track the details: one seed, six quiet days, a sprout on day seven, and three tomatoes by summer's end.
materials: Just you and this page — no materials needed
supervision: A grown-up nearby is recommended for younger readers; the think-and-talk questions work well read aloud together.
